headSHASemantics: This is the exact implementation and focused-test commit. The following documentation-only commit records the evidence.
scope: Native Renderers settings management over the existing machine package store and wiki renderer-settings seams.

success: The Renderers tab exposes Installed on This Mac and Enabled for This Wiki as separate scopes.
Installation accepts one local directory and routes it through validation and machine-store activation.
Removal retains a redacted removed machine record, deletes only the package payload, and leaves wiki enablement and source preferences separate.
Safe-mode reset refreshes the host projection. Registry refresh does not mutate active session pins.
Source version selection stores an exact typed renderer reference.
Diagnostics use progressive disclosure and the settings surface uses semantic body text and system colors.
error: Invalid directories remain on Source fallback through the existing validator and host failure boundary.
A missing machine store leaves installation and removal unavailable without changing wiki data.
boundary: Package bytes stay in the machine App Group store. Wiki renderer settings stay in the current wiki database.
The settings adapter does not construct renderer sessions or rewrite an existing RendererReference pin.
coverage.teardown: Focused tests remove temporary machine-store roots with explicit failure reporting.

bidirectionalResolution.command: inventory=plans/dynamic-renderers-phase7-management-test-inventory.json && jq -e '(.productionPaths | length > 0) and (.testPaths | length > 0) and all(.productionPaths[]; (.path | type == "string" and length > 0) and (.symbols | length > 0) and (.tests | length > 0))' "$inventory" >/dev/null && while IFS= read -r path; do test -f "$path" || exit 1; done < <(jq -r '.productionPaths[].path, .testPaths[]' "$inventory") && while IFS= read -r testName; do functionName=${testName##*.}; test $(rg -l -F "func ${functionName}(" $(jq -r '.testPaths[]' "$inventory") | wc -l | tr -d ' ') -eq 1 || exit 1; done < <(jq -r '[.productionPaths[].tests[]] | unique[]' "$inventory")'

excluded: PR merging, issue closure, and Phase 6 branch mutation
Hosted SwiftUI settings screenshots and VoiceOver output
Cross-process renderer event fan-out beyond the existing Phase 3 seams
honestCoverageLimits: The settings view contract test reads source text. It does not host a Settings window.
The focused version test proves the exact preference type. It does not create a live source database.
Full installation through a real user-selected package requires a hosted app test and remains a later Phase 7 validation slice.
The current implementation does not add a second renderer registry or change active pane lifecycle.
